'''Technologies''' are a game system in ''[[Graveyard Keeper 2]]''. The [[Keeper]] can unlock new items and workstations in the Tech Tree by spending {{Tech|Red}}, {{Tech|Green}}, and {{Tech|Blue}} points, which can be obtained in various ways. Some technologies are hidden or require certain reputation with another [[Characters|character]].

== Tech Tree ==
Technologies are divided into several branches, each with its own unlock tree.
